author: Good Enough
description:
Spies once used ordinary door handles as part of covert operations designed to target individuals without drawing attention.

During the Cold War, intelligence agencies experimented with methods that involved placing dangerous substances onto everyday objects, turning something as simple as a door handle into a hidden threat. The goal was to make the attack difficult to detect while avoiding suspicion.

This Short explores one of the most unsettling tactics ever associated with espionage and covert warfare.

#spies
title: Spies Used Door Handles as Weapons 🚪😲 #didyouknow #facts #history #coldwar

author: Good Enough
description:
You’re a spy, and one small mistake could be the difference between spotting the threat or missing it completely.

You’ll be tested on your ability to identify hidden weapons disguised as everyday objects, including items like a cane, a cigarette pack, and even something as small as a pen. Each one was designed to look harmless while hiding a dangerous secret.
title: Can You Spot The Hidden Spy Weapon? 🕵️‍♂️😲 #didyouknow #facts #coldwar
